collection.missing_result_policy: Missing results, exit statuses and completion times remain null; observed partial output is retained.

first_cli_tool_result.reason: No unique native shell output with successful structuredContent.sum exactly matched a verifier-confirmed capture.

native_command_count_scope: Unique agent Bash/command_execution invocations in phase order, including tester install commands; excludes Harbor startup and nested shells. Compound shell invocation counts once.
collection_timing_note: Step artifacts are collected after the orchestrator account-resolution hook. A blocked-step snapshot may already contain account resolution applied after the agent stopped. Use refusal/request timestamps and captured output for temporal attribution, not snapshot presence alone.
